Text.Value: I can't believe you're addicted to those chemicals. They're going to slow you down.
How can you fight when your brain's clouded with those drugs?
Quit now. That's all I have to say to you about those drugs you're taking.
A good soldier doesn't need crap like that to keep him going.
That stuff's poison. The sooner you realize it, the better.
Those chems are going ruin you, soldier.
Watch it! We only fire when we need to!
Keep shooting like that and you might accidentally hit something you care about.
Watch where you're firing that thing!
That's wasteful. I suggest you pick it back up.
Is that really necessary? I'd rather sell it for caps than drop it on the ground.
No, no, no. You can't go around dropping valuable things like that.
Time to suit up.
Feels like you can take on the world in there, doesn't it.
Now that's what I call locked and loaded.
You're pretty handy with that terminal. Haylen would be impressed.
Nice work. I've seen scribes take longer than that to hack a terminal.
Anything useful on that terminal?
Good work, don't leave anything behind.
Anything useful?
You never know what you'll find.
Amazing. I didn't even think that existed.
No, it couldn't be. I can't believe you found that!
I'll be damned. It's real.
Why are you bothering with that junk?
If you keep hoarding that garbage, you're going to slow us down.
I'd just leave that if I were you.
That's an interesting find. And still intact.
Feeling a bit nostalgic?
To you, that doesn't seem old. To me, it's an archeological relic.
That should keep you alive longer.
Outstanding. Proctor Ingram would be impressed.
That's a clever modification.
Nice craftsmanship.
You could teach Proctor Teagan a thing or two.
Bigger gun, bigger boom. Good job.
Well, that's a skill they don't teach in boot camp.
I've heard of breaching a door, but this is a lot quieter.
Outstanding. Let's open it up.
I don't think we should be doing this.
Hold on, this could be a bad idea.
I think I'm going to look the other way.
We need to get out of this radiation... now.
We're taking too many rads. We need to move out.
Geiger's going crazy on my suit.
We stay here too long, we're going to get sick.
I really don't think that's a good idea.
I wish you wouldn't take risks like that.
That really isn't part of our mission.
Why swim when you can walk?
I'll just meet you on the other side.
This isn't the Navy, you know.
Building something?
Feeling creative today?
I hope this has something to do with our mission.
Put your uniform on!
Get some clothes on, you're embarrassing us.
Is that absolutely necessary?
Call me old-fashioned, but there's nothing better than being boots on the ground.
Remember, we're out here representing the Brotherhood. Let's make them proud.
Doesn't it feel good to be a part of something as important as the Brotherhood?
With the Brotherhood behind us, we'll never fall.
I'm pleased we were assigned to the same team. I think we can learn a lot from each other.
There's a wealth of technology just waiting to be discovered out here.
I think you should stay on point. Your instincts seem to be right on target.
Give me a laser rifle and my power armor, and I'll take on the world.
If we want to win the people's hearts and minds, we have to spread the word of the Brotherhood across the Commonwealth.
There's Brotherhood, then there's everything else. Nothing in between.
You watch my back, I'll watch yours.
It's getting late. Should we bivouac out here or find a place to stay?
We're losing our nighttime cover... we need to move cautiously.
Another day, another assignment.
It's clear tonight. We should be able to spot any hostiles at a decent range.
Strange how the Commonwealth changes so much at night, isn't it.
We should make good time when the weather's this clear.
Damn rain. I hope it doesn't rust out my suit again.
Be ready for anything.
Now this place holds promise. Let's look around.
Brotherhood scribes never tire of rummaging through places like this.
I hope your safety's off... this place does not look friendly.
The first thing that jumps out at us is getting a laser to the face.
There could be a lockbox or a safe around. No harm in checking.
Turning this place over is a waste of time if you ask me.
If there's anything I can't stand, it's an unorganized mess.
Watch your step around here.
I'm not sure we're going to find anything of use in a place like this.
Watch what you fire at in here. You never know what explodes and what doesn't.
If we're fortunate, we might be able to recover some weapons or ammunition from this site.
Let's keep a tight formation in here... I don't want to lose you to something we can't see.
I can feel the chill of this place through my suit.
Keep your eyes on the shadows. Something could be lurking there.
Keep your safeties off.
Remain vigilant... something isn't right here.
Watch for ambushes and check your fire.
I'd definitely say that we're on the right track. Proceed with extreme caution.
I wouldn't advise staying here any longer than necessary.
Stay close.
Watch your step.
Look at this place.
Ad victoriam!
For the Brotherhood!
Lock and load!
This is the part of the job that I love!
Safety's off!
Let's show them how the Brotherhood does it!
No mercy!
Kill them all!
No prisoners!
Remember the Citadel!
For honor! For glory!
Let's get to it, people!
We do this clean and quiet. No heroics and by the book.
Hold up.
What the hell do you want?
Check your fire, we've got hostiles!
Just turn around, and walk away.
You watch my back, I'll watch yours.
Where do these fools come from? They seem to multiply like vermin.
Ugh. Diseased filth.
I loathe wasting precious ammunition on these vermin.
These fools are nothing but cold-blooded murderers.
No problem, I've got this.
Hostiles coming in.
Look alive, we've got company.
Going weapons hot.
Locked and loaded.
Let's clear the roadblock.
It's Danse. Paladin Danse. Don't you recognize me?
Well, we have our next target.
Stand down, or we'll be forced to defend ourselves!
This is going to be a pleasure.
Mission accomplished.
Threat neutralized.
Standing down.
Cease fire!
Target eliminated.
That's how we do it in the Brotherhood.
Hostile vaporized.
We're clear.
Going weapons cold.
Sent them back to hell.
Tango down.
Long live the Brotherhood.
Outstanding.
Well, that could have gone smoother, but mission accomplished.
You're one hell of a soldier, you know that?
I feel better knowing you have my back.
I have to admit, I'm very impressed. You're quite a soldier.
It's a pleasure to be a part of a team you can depend on.
You were born to be a soldier.
I have to admit, I feel pretty damn secure when you've got my back.
Well done, soldier.
That was interesting.
Just because we're soldiers doesn't mean we can't enjoy the spoils.
I hope that's the last of them.
Outstanding, soldier.
Area secured. Let's move out.
Nicely done.
Bigger gun, bigger boom.
For Elder Maxson!
For the Brotherhood!
Maintain your position!
Hold your ground!
Send them back to hell!
Aim for their weak spot!
Light 'em up!
Suppressing fire!
Pin them down!
Shock and awe!
Fight to the last man!
Ad victoriam!
Goddamn it, I've had it!
The Commonwealth will never be safe with these idiots running around.
Time to pay for your crimes!
I've heard of coming up with improvised field rations, but that's just disgusting.
